images.alt:
Cyclists arriving on the walking and cycling trail at the Mussel Inn, Golden Bay. 

Photo by Golden Bay Cycle and Walkways Society

post.text:
The Outdoor Access Commission is supporting plans for a coast-to-coast walking and cycling trail that will connect communities across Golden Bay — unlocking new opportunities for recreation, tourism, and connection with the whenua. 🚶‍♂️🚴‍♀️
Read the story: www.herengaanuku.govt.nz/our-work/new...
